applicableAreas: All sheets with Austin Energy service shown
findings.observation: Examined Sheet 3 (General Notes) Block 8 and Block 14 containing electric notes, Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) Block 6 containing utility notes. Sheet 3 contains "Electric Notes" section with 5 items covering tree rights, easement access, erosion control, clearances, and relocation costs. Sheet 21 title includes word "Preliminary" but contains no disclaimer. No note found on any sheet stating that electric facilities shown are conceptual in nature, should not be used for bidding purposes, or that final electric design by Austin Energy may vary from that shown on plans.
findings.reasoning: The requirement per AEDC 1.16.0 is for a note explicitly stating three elements: (1) conceptual nature of facilities, (2) not for bidding purposes, and (3) final design may vary. While Sheet 21 title indicates "Preliminary Electrical Design Plan," this alone does not constitute the required disclaimer note. The Electric Notes sections reviewed contain no such disclaimer. The absence of this specific note in the Austin Energy notes sections is a deficiency.
findings.comment: No note present stating that electric facilities shown are conceptual only and should not be used for bidding purposes. Add note stating: Electric facilities shown on this plan are conceptual only and should not be used for bidding purposes. Final electric design by Austin Energy may vary from that shown on this plan and may require changes to the site plan.

applicableAreas: All sheets with Austin Energy service shown
findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 3 Block 8 (Electric Notes) and Block 20 (Electric Transmission Notes). Block 8 contains 5 distribution-level notes covering tree rights, easements, erosion control, clearances, and relocation. Block 20 contains 16 transmission-specific notes, including transmission Note #2 which states: "Grading near electric transmission facilities must be coordinated with Austin Energy." No note found that comprehensively addresses the requirement for Austin Energy review of all plan changes that may affect electric service, including changes to building square footage, building location, detention facility location, grading, and spoil site locations.
findings.reasoning: EL-18.3 requires a note explicitly stating that "Austin Energy must review any changes to plans that may affect electric requirements, including changes in building square footage, building location, detention facilities location, grading, and spoil site locations." While transmission Note #2 requires coordination of grading near transmission facilities, this is limited to transmission-only coordination and does not address the broader requirement to review all change types (building square footage, location, detention facilities, spoil sites) as required by AEDC 1.16.0. The note must be in the Austin Energy Notes section (not just transmission section) and must cover all specified change types.
findings.comment: No comprehensive note present requiring Austin Energy review of changes. Add note stating: Austin Energy must review any changes to this plan that may affect electric service requirements, including but not limited to changes in building square footage, building location, detention facility location, grading, and spoil site locations.

findings.observation: Examined Sheet 3 General Notes. Vision analysis confirms two section headings: "Electric Notes" (Block 8) and "Electric Transmission Notes" (Block 20). The distribution/standard notes section is labeled "Electric Notes" rather than "Austin Energy Notes." The transmission section is labeled "Electric Transmission Notes" rather than "Austin Energy Transmission Notes." Checklist requires exact heading text "Austin Energy Notes."
findings.reasoning: Per General Site Plan Notes requirements and AEDC 1.16.0, the standard heading for utility notes specific to Austin Energy must read exactly "Austin Energy Notes." The use of "Electric Notes" as the heading, while descriptive, does not comply with the required standardized heading. The General Site Plan Notes document preface states: "Changing the required text in your plan set will result in rejection of the application." Standardized headings are part of the required text.
findings.comment: Section heading reads "Electric Notes" instead of required "Austin Energy Notes." Change all instances of "Electric Notes" heading to "Austin Energy Notes" and "Electric Transmission Notes" heading to "Austin Energy Transmission Notes."

findings.observation: Examined Sheet 3 General Notes content blocks. Found that the Electric Notes content (5 items covering tree rights, easement access, erosion control, clearances, relocation) appears in multiple locations on the same sheet: (1) Block 8 labeled "Electric Notes" with numbered 1-5 format; (2) Block 14 containing the same verbatim content in paragraph form without numbering; (3) Additional unnumbered, unheaded duplicate paragraph block in middle column per vision analysis. This creates three instances of the same notes on a single sheet.
findings.reasoning: The requirement per Reviewer Convention is that Austin Energy Notes section should appear in a single, unified location on the plan set. Duplicating the same notes across multiple blocks on the same sheet creates confusion, increases document size unnecessarily, and violates the convention that utilities should be noted once in a clear, organized manner. The presence of Block 8 (labeled section), Block 14 (duplicate paragraph), and additional unnumbered paragraph block constitutes duplication.
findings.comment: Austin Energy Notes appear in multiple locations on Sheet 3 (Blocks 8 and 14, plus additional unnumbered duplicate block). Consolidate all Electric/Austin Energy Notes into a single "Austin Energy Notes" section on this sheet and remove duplicate blocks.

applicableAreas: Sheets showing electrical infrastructure (Sheet 21 Preliminary Electrical Design Plan)
findings.observation: Examined Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) which shows underground electrical routing, transformer pads, and pull boxes across the site. Block 6 contains generic "Utility Notes" (4 items) instructing the contractor to verify existing utility locations, identify conflicts, and specify pipe materials for water and wastewater only. No note found addressing developer responsibility for conduit design and installation per Austin Energy Design Criteria Manual. The electrical design plan would be the appropriate location for this requirement if infrastructure will be developer-constructed.
findings.reasoning: AEDC 1.3.0 requires a note specifying developer responsibility for designing and constructing all conduit and related infrastructure to meet current Austin Energy Design Criteria Manual. The site plan shows preliminary electrical design with underground infrastructure routing, indicating developer involvement in electrical infrastructure installation. This note establishes clear responsibility for compliance with Austin Energy standards and for cost allocation of conductor installation. Its absence is a compliance gap.
findings.comment: No note present stating developer responsibility for conduit installation. Add note to Sheet 21 (or another appropriate electrical sheet) stating: Developer is responsible for designing and constructing all conduit and related infrastructure to meet current Austin Energy Design Criteria Manual, including the installation of conductors if determined during the design process (prior to issuance of building permit) that developer will fund the installation cost. Developer is also responsible for coordinating with other utilities to resolve conflicts. All costs are the responsibility of applicant.
